question_text: A 33-year-old woman comes to the physician because of a 3-day history of dry cough and low-grade fever. A diagnosis of upper respiratory infection is made and a medication is prescribed to relieve her symptoms. A drug with which of the following mechanisms of action should be avoided in this patient?
